title: Proofs of Lupu's conjectures for multiple zeta values and multiple $t$-values
summary: Let $r\ge 1$ be an integer. For any multiple index $\mathbf{s}=(s_1,s_2,\cdots,s_r) \in\mathbb{Z}_{\geq 1}^r$ with $s_r>1$, the multiple zeta value (MZV for short) is defined by \begin{align*} ζ(s_1,s_2,\cdots,s_r):=\sum_{1\leq k_1<k_2<\cdots<k_r} \frac{1}{k_1^{s_1}k_2^{s_2}\cdots k_r^{s_r}} \end{align*} and the multiple $t$-value is defined by \begin{align*} t(s_1,s_2,...,s_r):=\sum_{1\leq k_1<k_2<...<k_r} \frac{1}{(2k_1-1)^{s_1}(2k_2-1)^{s_2}...(2k_r-1)^{s_r}}, \end{align*} where if the index is empty, then we define the value $t(\emptyset):=1$.
